settings.companyHint: Applies to every listing and everyone on the staff.

settings.parallelStartHint: On: a cleaner may have several cleanings under way at once — that is how a floor is done, one person across every room. Off: the time measurement assumes one cleaning at a time.
settings.galleryHint: Off: photos and video are taken with the camera, on the spot. On: a cleaner may attach a file from the gallery — including one taken in another flat or a week ago, and then the media is no longer evidence of the state of the flat at the time of the cleaning. Applies to cleanings and to tasks alike.
